caption:
The best advice I can give for depression 

#depression #healthybodyhealthymind #mindsetmatters
transcript: When you're depressed, you don't collapse, you freeze, you stay in one spot. The body becomes heavy, the mind repeats the same thoughts, and the best advice I can give you is simple. Move. Not fast, not perfectly. Just move. There are days when getting out of bed feels impossible. Your legs feel like they weigh a thousand pounds. You don't want to read, you don't want to work, you don't want to create, and still you stand up. Not because it's easy, but because movement brings life back into the body. Motivation does not come first. Action comes first. When you're depressed, don't try to fix everything. Just change your position. One step, one breath, one small movement. If this spoke to you, comment, move, so your body remembers what your mind forgot.
